# BilimAI — Neuro-Symbolic Mathematics Platform for UNT (ЕНТ / ҰБТ)

> BilimAI (https://bilimai.dpdns.org) is a free trilingual (Russian, Kazakh, Uzbek) diagnostic mathematics platform for high-school students (grades 9–11) preparing for the Unified National Testing (ЕНТ / ҰБТ) in Kazakhstan and Central Asia.

## Key Capabilities
- **16 Official UNT Mathematics Sections (100% NTsT RK Specification):** Linear equations, Inequalities & interval method, Systems of equations, Percentages & proportions, Probability & statistics, Combinatorics & logic, Powers & radicals, Quadratic equations & Vieta's formulas, Arithmetic & geometric progressions, Exponential & logarithmic equations, Trigonometry, Derivatives & extrema, Antiderivatives & definite integrals, Planimetry, Vectors & coordinates, Stereometry.
- **Error-Finding Lab (`/lab` — 1,152 Scenarios):** Students inspect 3 steps of a worked solution, identify the exact line where a mathematical invariant first breaks, study the repair, and solve a transfer problem with spaced repetition (2 and 7 days).
- **UNT Mock Exam Simulator (`/?tab=exam`):** Covers all 4 official UNT formats (single-choice 1 pt, contextual problems 1 pt, matching A/B → 1..4 for 2 pts, and multiple-choice up to 3 answers out of 6 for 2 pts with partial credit).
- **Interactive 16-Topic Knowledge Graph (`/?tab=graph`):** Prerequisite dependency map that distinguishes root gaps from blocked topics.
- **Socratic AI Tutor powered by Anthropic Claude API (`/api/explain`, `/api/lab-diagnose`, `/api/roadmap`):** Explains mathematical misconceptions in Russian, Kazakh, and Uzbek without spoiling the final answer.

## Primary Entry Points
- Study & Textbook (16 UNT topics): https://bilimai.dpdns.org/
- Error-Finding Trainer (1,152 tasks): https://bilimai.dpdns.org/lab
- UNT Mock Exam Simulator: https://bilimai.dpdns.org/?tab=exam
- Interactive 16-Topic Map: https://bilimai.dpdns.org/?tab=graph
- Personalized UNT Study Plan: https://bilimai.dpdns.org/?tab=roadmap
- Kazakh Interface (ҰБТ Математика): https://bilimai.dpdns.org/?lang=kk
- Uzbek Interface (Matematika): https://bilimai.dpdns.org/?lang=uz
- Startup & Architecture Overview: https://bilimai.dpdns.org/about
- Student Privacy Policy (Anonymous by Design): https://bilimai.dpdns.org/privacy
